meta.name: learn
meta.description: Distill a reusable skill from anything — a directory, a URL, pasted notes, or what you just did together — or refine an existing skill with new learnings. Use when the user says '/learn', 'learn this', 'turn this into a skill', 'capture this workflow', 'make a skill from <source>', or 'improve/update the <name> skill'. Produces or updates a .claude/skills/<name>/SKILL.md authored to NanoClaw's skill guidelines. (This CREATES or REFINES a skill from a source; it does not install existing skills from a registry.)

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 从任何来源提炼或改进可复用的技能
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要把操作流程固化为可复用的技能
copy.tagline_en: Distill or refine a reusable skill from any source
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to turn workflows into reusable skills

howto.what: 它会读取你指定的来源——目录、网址、粘贴的笔记,或你们刚做完的工作——提炼出可重复的步骤,生成或更新 .claude/skills/<name>/SKILL.md 技能文件。它只创建或改进技能,不从技能仓库安装现成技能。
howto.when: 当你说 /learn、“learn this”、“capture this workflow” 等指令,或要求把某个来源做成技能、改进已有技能时触发。

say.note: 抓取该网页并写出技能文件

say.text: /learn what we just did 把刚才的流程记下来
say.note: 把本次对话提炼成技能
就地更新已有技能,而非覆盖

howto.what_en: Reads the source you give it — a directory, URL, pasted notes, or the work just done — and distills a reusable procedure into a new or updated .claude/skills/<name>/SKILL.md. It creates or refines skills; it does not install existing ones.
howto.when_en: Triggers on /learn, "learn this", "capture this workflow" and similar phrases, or when you ask to turn a source into a skill or to refine an existing one.

say_en.note: Fetches the page and writes a skill file

say_en.text: /learn what we just did — capture this workflow
say_en.note: Distills this conversation into a skill
